rows.title: Kidney outcomes of coenzyme Q10 supplementation in patients with genetically confirmed CoQ10 nephropathy in Japan.
rows.focus: Retrospective observational study of 12 genetically confirmed CoQ10 nephropathy patients receiving CoQ10 supplementation. Proteinuria decreased substantially in those with available follow-up, kidney function remained stable, and reported adverse events were mild. Evidence remains disease-specific and observational.
